articles.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 4,000 deaths
articles.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has caused more than 4,000 deaths, health officials say. The rare Bundibugyo virus has no known treatment or vaccine, and unpaid wages and unrest are making the response harder.

articles.title: France closes nearly 400 schools after violent education protests
articles.summary: About 400 schools in France are expected to stay closed Friday after student protests over teacher shortages and run-down buildings turned violent in some places. The justice minister says 2,000 people have been arrested.

articles.title: NASA's Crew-13 aims for fastest U.S. trip to the space station
articles.summary: NASA planned for Crew-13 to reach the International Space Station in 7 hours and 50 minutes, which would be the fastest U.S. trip ever. Four crew members will spend an extended period aboard.
